perTypeExceptions._doc: Intentional deviations from the universal 155px horizontal margin for full-bleed accent slides. Centered layouts whose content never reaches the crop zone — NOT violations (#5368).

quote._reason: centered text-only layout — content never reaches crop zone

_comment_1to1: 1080x1080 (1:1) chosen over industry-standard 1080x1350 (4:5) because Instagram profile grid crops carousel covers to square, cutting off bottom ~150px of text. See #4500.
